title: World-model findings archive (not the paper)

advantage_alignment.note: R2_state_only = fraction of advantage variance explained by a per-start-state constant. High means the advantage carries no action signal. Needs --joint-ckpt: on a fresh zero-init critic both the old and fixed definitions are identically equal (finding 17).

reset_700k.note: Same frozen 600-episode replay. Plateau after ~500k. Host RAM OOM at 628150; resumed from 620k.

m4_ac_20k.note: Frozen 700k WM. Imagined reward ~0.017/step; λ-return ~2.6 is critic bootstrap. Notebook exit PASS.

SUPERSEDED by finding 17: this run and m7_xl_paper_40k both ran imag_gradient='both' (notebook never forwarded the config) with a V(s_t+1) advantage baseline, no slow critic and no discount weights.

findings.title: Auxiliary embed decoder is an RSSM bypass
findings.one_liner: A reconstruction path that skips z_posterior lets pixel loss fall while the world model stays empty.
findings.paper_spin: Implementation pitfall / identifiability appendix — not a new architecture.

findings.title: Mean pixel loss inverts the paper’s recon/KL ratio
findings.one_liner: Mean L1 is ~12288× smaller than sum-MSE on 64×64×3, so KL outvoted reconstruction.
findings.paper_spin: One-paragraph reduction mismatch with the 0.15 vs 57 bar chart.

findings.title: Free-nats on kl_dyn freezes the prior
findings.one_liner: Flooring the dynamics KL zeros prior gradients; movers are then dropped from a 1-nat posterior budget.
findings.paper_spin: KL-balancing appendix: floor ≠ setpoint; dyn vs rep floors are not interchangeable.

findings.title: Crafter’s 7px tiles vs a 4×4 latent
findings.one_liner: One latent cell is 16×16 px. Nearest upsample and tile-mean blob losses cannot represent 7px sprites or 4px HUD glyphs.
findings.paper_spin: Geometry figure: annotated 7px grid + nearest vs sub-pixel HUD.

findings.title: Ghost movers are MSE + coverage, not a missing head
findings.one_liner: Sapling/cow/zombie residue at 50k–700k means bits without commitment. Crop losses are how we fought the RSSM for two weeks.
findings.paper_spin: Limitations: reconstructions are not sprite sheets; residue vs absence distinguishes this from finding 01.

findings.title: Table 4 vs size-S YAML KL scales
findings.one_liner: With honest sum-MSE, dyn=0.5/rep=0.1 lets the posterior buy bits (KL 6.2 at 1950). 700k at dyn=1/rep=0.5 plateaus near 2 nats, never the floor.
findings.paper_spin: Reimplementation note; 700k curve is the floor≠setpoint figure.

findings.title: Dashboard signals that are not in the weights
findings.one_liner: Empty resume history, log-continue, embed-vs-[h,z] panels, bf16 open-loop gray, and free_nats drawn as a target all lie.
findings.paper_spin: Evaluation subsection so those screenshots never become figures.

findings.title: 16 GiB constraints that changed the recipe
findings.one_liner: seq 64 fits and thrashes. Host RAM OOMed at 628k on a matplotlib strip. M5 notebook dashboard every 16 env steps decayed 18→1.1 env/s by 58k.
findings.paper_spin: Hardware / limitations appendix — honest small-scale study, not a DreamerV3 score.

findings.title: Frozen-replay WM steps plateau after ~500k
findings.one_liner: 500k→700k moved recon L1 0.00468→0.00452 and KL 2.03→1.96. DreamerV3’s 1M is online env steps, not decoder epochs on 600 random episodes.
findings.paper_spin: Limitations / compute: stop the frozen-buffer run at the plateau; do not treat 1M gradient steps as the paper budget.

findings.title: Imagined λ-return is not Crafter skill on a frozen random-policy WM
findings.one_liner: M4 last-2k: reward 0.017/step vs λ-return 2.61. The return curve is critic bootstrap under γ=0.997, not achievements. M4 passed; M5 real eval is still not geo-mean (finding 11).
findings.paper_spin: Evaluation: any imagined-return figure must show per-step reward beside λ-return or it will be read as a Crafter curve.

findings.title: 4×400-step eval return is one achievement then die
findings.one_liner: M5 100k eval return is mean_achievements − 0.9 (Crafter +1 unlock, −0.1 damage). Last 0.10 with length ~180–220. Not a geo-mean Crafter score.
findings.paper_spin: Evaluation: plot achievements and episode length next to 4-episode return, or it will be read as DreamerV3’s Crafter curve. Geo-mean is M6.

findings.title: A 400-step collect cap is a second Crafter time-limit
findings.one_liner: M5 lengths 180–220 so the 400 cap was idle. Crafter is 10k. Mapping gym done to terminated would store continue=0 on timeout. M6 cap 10000; continue follows info.discount.
findings.paper_spin: Eval protocol: state episode length 10000. Do not train at 400 and score at 10k.

findings.title: M6 1M gmean is 1.6; they still die at ~190 steps
findings.one_liner: Protocol PASS. Held-out gmean 0.627→1.639, online 1.941. Collect max length 441 / mean 190 so the 10k cap is idle. n=10 eval is a lottery (900k 0.43, 1M 1.64). Not DreamerV3 14.5.
findings.paper_spin: Results: captioned size-S 1M number + length plot. Limitations: survival, not diamonds, is the missing skill; 10-episode eval is variance.

findings.title: XL from scratch collapsed the actor by 20k env steps
findings.one_liner: 198M XL, fresh actor, random WM. Entropy on unimix floor (~0.08) by 20k. Held-out 1.298→0.233, wake_up only. Prefill exits after one episode. Do not grind to 1M.
findings.paper_spin: Negative result: 200M is not the missing piece once the actor is a delta on unimix. Recipe: 10k prefill that stops at one life is not the paper seed.

findings.title: Paper train_ratio 512 on this box is ~2 env/s
findings.one_liner: M7 v2 at 40k is 2.14 env/s because 16 WM+16 AC / 16 env, not a hung dashboard. 37/16≈2.3 vs M6. 1M is ~5.4 days; cancelled. Next is ratio 32 in a new dir. Seq 32 also doubles paper-torch’s 8 updates/16 env.
findings.paper_spin: Hardware appendix: seq 32 to fit 16 GiB doubled Crafter optimizer steps vs torch seq 64. Do not silently drop train_ratio to finish overnight.

findings.title: XL + M6 update count still collapses the actor by 20k
findings.one_liner: Workstation ratio 32 is 26 env/s and dead: ac_H ~0.09 from 20k, held-out 1.69→0.50. Prefill/pretrain/reinforce did not replace train_ratio 512. Do not grind to 1M.
findings.paper_spin: Negative result with finding 14/15: finishable XL-from-scratch on this box collapses; paper-ratio XL is a 5-day run.

findings.title: The M7 actor collapse was six actor-critic implementation bugs, not size or train_ratio
findings.one_liner: Advantage baseline used V(s_t+1) not V(s_t); critic target off by one; no slow critic; no discount weights; critic loss leaked into the actor; and the notebook never forwarded imag_gradient, so both XL runs summed the straight-through dynamics term that DreamerV3 weights at 0 for discrete actions.
findings.paper_spin: Implementation-identifiability section: six divergences, each silent in the loss curves, all presenting as entropy → unimix floor. An off-by-one advantage baseline is exactly zero-error at init under critic.outscale 0.0, so no shape/grad/smoke test can catch it.

findings.title: XL at train_ratio 32 was paging 16 GiB, not a failed AC fix
findings.one_liner: M8-XL ~22k is 5 env/s at 15.7/16.3 GiB and 88 W. M7 XL same ratio was 26 env/s. ac_H 0.50 not the 0.08 floor. Unused encode/observe/img_step autograd on reinforce allocated the paging line.
findings.paper_spin: Hardware appendix: a discarded dynamics graph plus WDDM clients turns a 10-hour 1M into 55 hours without changing the loss.

findings.title: The ~200-step death is combat, not hunger and not a cap
findings.one_liner: No-combat starvation is step 338; at 200 health is still 9. 66% of M8-XL lives end at 150–220. Drinking buys ~60 steps; defeat_zombie is 0.6%. Sleeping zombies deal 7.
findings.paper_spin: Crafter death-clock figure: do not treat mean length 190 as a hunger proxy until defeat_zombie is common.

findings.title: The 14.5 gap is a different experiment, not a missing loss head
findings.one_liner: 14.5 is XL at 1M with train_ratio 512, seq 64, streaming replay, GRU 4096. M8-XL was ratio 32, seq 32, finished-episode replay, GRU 2560, at 80k. M9 closes the V2 sampler (is_first + stream). Still 16x less replay per env step.
findings.paper_spin: Compute/protocol figure: same 1M x-axis is 16x less replay and 8x fewer updates. Do not read 1.36 vs 14.5 as a missing reconstruction head.

findings.title: The 400k flat gmean is a skill island, not a dead trainer
findings.one_liner: M9 last-200 gmean 2.49 vs cumulative 2.56. wake_up ~93%, stone 0, zombie peaked 21% then fell. Held-out 2.82 is n=10 luck (350k was 1.39). Continuing this actor at ratio 128 did not buy survival (finding 22).
findings.paper_spin: Eval: cumulative Crafter gmean saturates; plot last-N lives. Sleep+plant island does not move mean length off ~180.

findings.title: Continuing the sleep-island actor does not buy survival
findings.one_liner: M10 ratio 128 on M9 400k: +120k env, mean length still 183, wake_up 97%, held-out 2.25→1.76. RESUME=auto then loaded 500k. From-scratch 128 is finding 23.
findings.paper_spin: Raising train_ratio mid-run on a policy that already sleeps every life is not the paper’s 512-from-scratch curve.

findings.title: Ratio 128 from scratch is the sleep island by 135k
findings.one_liner: M11 at 135k: last-200 gmean ~2.0, length 177, wake_up 96.5%, zombie 1%, stone 0. M9 at the same env had 12.5% zombie. ac_H ~0.4. Do not grind to 1M.
findings.paper_spin: A 4× train_ratio from scratch can lock wake_up sooner rather than delay the island.
